candidates.title: WarmServe: Enabling One-for-Many GPU Prewarming for Multi-LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Multi-LLM serving system that uses workload predictability to prewarm multiple models on GPUs, targeting burst handling and TTFT while improving shared-cluster resource efficiency.

candidates.title: SUN: Shared Use of Next-token Prediction for Efficient Multi-LLM Disaggregated Serving
candidates.reason: Distinct multi-model serving design enabling shared decode execution via common frozen decode modules and model-agnostic routing; reports throughput-per-GPU gains and supports quantized shared decoding.
